latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Generate 30-second promotional videos from text or images with automatic cloud-based editing.

- Instantly create and export ready-to-share 1080p videos from user text and image uploads.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 200MB; outputs downloadable MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple, guided user flow: upload files, send instructions, receive download links.
- Includes workflows for uploading, credit checking, export management, and state tracking.
- No professional editing skills required — ideal for marketers, creators, students.
